name: sunear-designer-stage
description: Internal Stage plugin for testing Sunear door and window design workflows through OAuth-protected MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Internal testing only - never use for customer production projects.
interface.longDescription: Internal Sunear testing plugin. It combines all supplied drawings into one evidence-backed Project, signs in through the isolated Stage account system, and hands required review, configuration, and quotation steps to Sunear Web.
defaultPrompt: 把本次提供的全部 PDF 作为一个来源集，在 Sunear Stage 中创建一个项目并完成产品清单与门窗设计校验。
Use all supplied drawings as one source set, create one Sunear Stage project, and validate its product list and complete door/window designs.
